# SourceTrack

> SourceTrack is a privacy-first marketing attribution and lightweight web analytics platform for founders, marketers, and SaaS teams.

## Core Features
- AI Referral Tracking: Detects visits originating from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Copilot.
- Multi-Touch Attribution: Supports first-touch, last-touch, linear, and time-decay attribution models.
- Visitor Journey Inspector: View the complete pre-conversion touchpoint timeline for any lead or customer.
- Search Console Integration: Matches GSC organic queries and landing pages to revenue.
- Cookieless Identity Moat: first-party and cookieless, without cross-site tracking or fingerprinting.
